info.title: WattWise AI â Energy Skills
info.description: Household electricity management skills. Use these to query energy data, get bill projections, detect anomalies, and get AI-powered saving tips.

get.description: Returns a complete real-time energy snapshot for the household. Includes today's consumption, this month's total and projected bill, the top energy-consuming appliance, and anomaly count. Use this as the first call to understand the household's current energy situation.

Returns all appliances registered in the household with their wattage, daily usage hours, and calculated daily/monthly kWh consumption. Use this to understand what appliances are in the home and their energy impact.

get.summary: Get current month electricity bill estimate
get.description: Returns the projected electricity bill for the current month based on consumption so far. Includes days elapsed, kWh consumed, projected end-of-month kWh and cost, and budget status. Use this to answer questions like 'What will my electricity bill be?'

Returns a list of anomalous electricity consumption events detected in the past 30 days. Each anomaly includes which appliance behaved unusually, when it happened, how much it consumed, and a plain-English explanation. Use this to answer questions like 'What was unusual about my energy use recently?'

Uses IBM Granite to generate personalized electricity-saving tips based on the household's actual appliance data, consumption patterns, and anomalies. Use this to answer questions like 'How can I lower my electricity bill?' or 'What are some tips to save energy at home?'

post.summary: Chat with WattWise AI energy advisor
post.description: Send a natural language message to the WattWise AI energy advisor powered by IBM Granite. The advisor has full context of the household's energy data and can answer questions, provide explanations, give tips, and interpret consumption patterns. Use this for any free-form energy question from the user.
